Arete.Label: Arete
Arete.RollHint: Roll Attribute, Skill, Skill (one is enough); Arete is the prize of the description
Arete.SelectTraitWarning: Pick at least one trait: an Attribute or a Skill.
Arete.WitnessesHint: Someone saw you do it, +2 Paradox.
Arete.NoSpheres: No Sphere with dots: unlock Spheres in Magick to use them here.
Arete.PrizeHint: If the description honours the Instrument, or the Creed, or invents an effect beyond the tables: extra dice equal to Arete ({arete}), within the +3 cap together with Harmony and Bonuses.
Arete.PrizeHybrid: Hybrid Magick never takes the prize.
Arete.HarmonyHint: The dice other Mages give you: one from anyone sharing your Creed or your Type, two from anyone sharing both, always with a Sphere in common. Count them at the table. Magick and Technomagick do not harmonise with each other; Hybrid does with both.
Arete.ThresholdHint: The threshold is the higher of the highest Sphere and the highest Scope, +1 with three or more Spheres, cap 7; then +1 for each Scope beyond the first, and those go past the cap. Click the dots: the Sphere level you use, the level of each Scope.
Arete.AutoVictory: Automatic victory: the pool is at least twice the threshold, no roll. In Vulgar Magick only the red dice are rolled.
Arete.AutoVictoryChat: Automatic victory: pool {pool} against threshold {threshold}, no roll.
Arete.RedOnly: Automatic victory (pool {pool}, threshold {threshold}): only the red dice are rolled. If Backlash strikes, Burn {burn}, equal to the threshold.
Arete.OneStep: One step short: {missing} successes missing, within Arete ({arete}). Success at a price.
Arete.SpecialtyHint: Specialty: declare this Scope and the roll starts with as many successes as your Arete. The threshold does not change.
Arete.ThresholdShort: Threshold: the higher of Sphere and Scope, +1 with three Spheres, cap 7. Scopes beyond the first add +1 each and go past the cap.
Arete.Backlash: BACKLASH: {eyes} eyes on the red dice. Burn {burn}: mark {burn} damage on Health.
Arete.QuintessenceHint: Each point spent is an automatic success and leaves the Wheel. If the effect deals damage, it is aggravated.

ConceptChallenge.Label: The Concept Challenge
ConceptChallenge.Hint: Answer in writing: rough notes are enough. There is no right order, so begin with the group that inspires you most.

description.Label: Description
description.Prompt: What first impression do they make on a stranger, or on two people exchanging a few words?

mask.Label: The Mask
mask.Prompt: What do others believe about them at first glance, and what is only a façade?

routine.Label: The Routine
routine.Prompt: What is their typical day like? What ritual could they never give up, no matter how boring?

livelihood.Label: The Livelihood
livelihood.Prompt: What work have they done? Do they choose from passion, necessity, or jump from job to job?

spark.Label: Spark
spark.Prompt: Name three talents or virtues anyone would recognize in them.

cracks.Label: Cracks
cracks.Prompt: Name two flaws, quirks, or vices that complicate their life or relationships.

outlet.Label: Release Valve
outlet.Prompt: What makes them feel good right away: a beer, an engine, or an endless TV series?

roots.Label: Roots
roots.Prompt: What was their adolescence like? At the center of the group, on the margins, a rebel, or just passing through?

skeleton.Label: Skeleton in the Closet
skeleton.Prompt: An error, secret, or regret they pray will never resurface.

monster.Label: The Monster under the Bed
monster.Prompt: Their most irrational fear: nothing supernatural, but spiders, heights, or going home alone.

pressure.Label: Under Pressure
pressure.Prompt: When everything slips from their grasp, do they explode, shut down, run, think, lie, or analyze coldly?

redLine.Label: The Red Line
redLine.Prompt: The one thing they would refuse to do, no matter how high the stakes.

refuge.Label: The Refuge
refuge.Prompt: Where do they go, or what do they do, when they only want to disappear for a couple of hours?

superstition.Label: Profane Superstition
superstition.Prompt: An ordinary fixation or superstition, such as a recurring routine or an object chosen blindly.

beacon.Label: Beacon
beacon.Prompt: The most important human person in their life today: a partner, parent, child, friend, or trusted doctor.

thorn.Label: Thorn in the Side
thorn.Prompt: Their everyday antagonist: an intrusive neighbor, an unfair boss, a resentful ex. Why?

securityBlanket.Label: The Security Blanket
securityBlanket.Prompt: A commonplace but irreplaceable object they always carry.

lastSupper.Label: The Last Supper
lastSupper.Prompt: If the world ended tomorrow, how and with whom would they spend their final evening as a mortal?

drive.Label: Drive
drive.Prompt: The dream that makes them human, the inspiration behind their Awakening.

embodiment.Label: Embodiment
embodiment.Prompt: Up to three things they, the player, and the storyteller have in common: a hobby, fear, or ideal.

distance.Label: Distance
distance.Prompt: At least three things in which you are profoundly different: the boundary between you and them.

Scopes.Label: Scopes
Scopes.TableHint: Each Scope is declared at a level from 1 to 7. The threshold is the higher of the highest Sphere and the highest Scope (cap 7); each Scope beyond the first raises it by 1, even past the cap. Potency (Effect): how big the feat is. Potency (Damage): Arete plus the number. Duration: when casting you declare whether it runs on play or on narrative time.

precision.3: The man with the raised eyebrow in the crowd
precision.4: The right key on the ring
